question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Grave
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Grave"** means serious or solemn in manner or appearance; giving cause for concern. (गंभीर)

 
 
• **Example: **The doctor **gave** him a grave look, indicating the seriousness of the situation.
 
 
 
• **"Humorous" **refers to something that is funny or makes people laugh; it is the opposite of being serious. (हास्यपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **His **humorous** comments lightened the mood during the tense meeting.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Grave' **is **'Humorous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Low **(निम्न): Of less than average height from top to bottom or to the ground.

 
 
• **Example:** The low fence did not provide much security.
 
 
 
• **Living **(जीवित): Alive; not dead.
 
 
• **Example: **She was grateful to be living after the accident.
 
 
 
• **Belittle** (तुच्छ): Make someone or something seem less impressive or important.
 
 
• **Example:** It is not right to belittle someone else's achievements.
